about: V2.1b offline retrieval eval set (KARAR-2 embeddings decision). Records are fictional; every query term also appears in another project so a scope leak would show. delta (JARVIS operator memory) holds the exact, update and tr_en queries: an update pair lists the old record first (older), and the query's stale record must rank below the expected one.
